items.q: What makes Subur different from regular honey?
items.a: Subur is more than honey. It is raw honeycomb blended with nine other ingredients - nuts, spices and roots - each one named on the label.
Take one teaspoon every morning on an empty stomach.

items.q: How long should I take Subur?
items.a: Subur is designed to be part of your daily routine. Consistent use is recommended for the best results.

items.q: Is Subur for men or women?
items.a: Subur is made for both men and women. The blend includes ingredients valued for supporting overall wellbeing and fertility.

items.q: Can husband and wife take Subur together?
items.a: Yes. Many couples choose to take Subur together as part of their daily wellness routine.
No. Subur is made using natural ingredients and contains no artificial colours or artificial flavours.
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Always keep the lid tightly closed after use.

items.q: Where can I buy Subur Honey in Malaysia?
items.a: Only through Berkat Madinah Store: its two Selangor branches in Ampang Jaya and Batu Caves, its own Shopee storefront, its own TikTok Shop, or WhatsApp. Those are one shop reached several ways, not separate sellers - Subur is not stocked in supermarkets or pharmacies.
